meta.title: Search the PR list by part of the PR number

plan.title: Search PR list by number prefix

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions list for the buyer.

args.goal: In the Purchase Requisitions list, click the search box above the table, enter the supplied first six digits of the known PR number, press Enter, and stop on the filtered results list showing every returned PR number contains those digits.

steps.note: Perform and verify the PR-number prefix search despite the catalog lacking a dedicated PR search step.
Assert that the filtered PR results table contains at least the known matching PR.
